content: Yesu tǝvuukwa Bilatus

Dlakadur bawura, kaa ɗiya sawari kǝ maalaha zhiil kǝsauufaha, ard tlǝvuukwah ard lii tsaga adzahadzaha Musa, ard dzahava lii ma gyiɗ baɗǝmma. Kaa ngwaɗǝnangwaɗǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ Yesu, ar langda da tǝvuukwa Bilatusa, ar fardǝm ma dǝva.
Kaa ndavgaruundavǝg nǝ Bilatus kǝ Yesu taakiya, “Kǝgh tlǝkǝssa Yahudaha?” Ngwugharangug Yesu amaa, “Aana, bandkwa tagǝda nǝnga.”
Kaa ghwadgarǝva ǝlbǝgah ba ɗyak nǝ maalaha zhiila kǝsauufaha.
Kaa gwiya ndavgarundavǝg nǝ Bilatus taakiya, “Agha maay mbǝɗa ghai biya? Cinng kǝ dǝgitahi ar tag nǝ iitǝr tǝghǝr kǝskǝgh ba ɗyaka.”
Gwastǝna, mbǝɗabi Yesu kǝ ghaiyan biya, kwana vǝlgharvǝlǝg kǝ Bilatus kǝ dǝga jappǝr.
Ghudavardaghudǝg nǝ shariya ǝmtsǝg kǝ Yesu
Dǝgiti nǝt tlǝkǝs kǝ ɓagaan sarta hwaɗaga iin taakiya, ɓǝlars kǝ uud palla kwa ghalga nǝ uudah sagal ma guda bǝrfina.
Mǝng nǝ uuda nǝ iin ɗaagaan Barabbas kwa ɓǝlaavdǝm ma guda bǝrfina, ǝmtaɗ dǝ lii dzagwara dlagwam kwa tsara uuda ma sartǝn ciyit nǝ dlagwamǝna.
Kaa sagau kǝ dzahava dlamakǝlaaw da ghala Bilatus maa ɓagtǝra kǝ dǝgiti nǝt nǝ iina kǝ ɓagaana.
Ngwatǝrangug nǝ Bilatus amaa, “Am naagaan ǝn ɓǝlkurnǝs kǝ tlǝkǝssa Yahudaha?”
Aɗaba nǝghaakanǝghǝg nǝ Bilatus taakiya, ba shilǝg wa fatǝra maalah zhiilakǝsauufah kǝ vǝlla Yesu damma dǝvaana
Maalaha zhiilakǝsauufah wa shaharant uudah kǝ taakiya aa ɓǝlkǝmndarsɓǝlǝg nǝ uud kǝ Barabaas tǝghǝr kǝ Yesu.
Kaa ndavtǝrundavǝg nǝ Bilatus taakiya, “Au kaci wanda ɓag nai dǝ kwam ɗaag nǝ uuram dǝ tlǝkǝssa Yahudahni?”
Ar ɗǝyaru kǝ iitǝr kǝ cau ar taakiya, “Aa hǝrtǝvǝthǝrtǝgga!”
Aiyam nǝ Bilatus taa kǝ iitǝra, “Mbakyauwi? Au nǝ haipaani?” Ar gwiya dzǝgant kǝ kungy ar taakiya, “Aa hǝrtǝvǝthǝrtǝgga!”
Naagaan tsau nǝ Bilatus hǝngtǝrna kǝ ǝrviɗmahuɗaatǝra, ɓǝltǝrnǝs kǝ Barabaas. Tǝhalakwa fǝgharaa nǝ iin kǝ uudah kǝ dlaghgaru kiiɓ kǝ Yesu, kaa vǝltǝr kǝ iin kiyava hǝrtǝgga.
Nenerneneg Tlaujah Kǝ Yesu
Kaa dadǝg nǝ tlaujah kǝ Yesu damma gaagazaiya vǝgya gumna. Ar dzahant kǝ tlaujah baɗǝmma.
Ar tsǝgwardǝm kǝ sǝdav kyang hulfa dǝga tlǝkǝssaha, dlaɓa ar ɓagara kǝ dzakwa takka, ar fardǝm ma ghǝra.
Ar farzha kǝ tagar uus taakiya, “Kǝm ma barkagh tlǝkǝssa Yahudaha!”
Kaa kalgaan kǝ iitǝr dǝ zad ma ghǝra, ar tafarǝva kǝ ashavaiya. Tǝhalakwaha ar kǝlla kǝ ghunj tǝvuukwana am nǝ iitǝra ar fǝgaaradfǝga.
Ghyǝngara ba nǝ iitǝr kǝ nenegaana, ar sǝɗarda kǝ sǝɗava tlǝksǝna, ar tsagwɗǝm ma sǝɗavahaana. Tǝhalakwaha ar langda dagal da gyǝmal kiyava hǝrtǝgaana.
Hǝrtavǝthǝtǝg nǝ Yesu

Ar tǝghǝrdǝga dagala, kaa nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ uuda nǝ iin ghwudadagal, kwa ɗahav dǝ Siman, zhiila Sayirina, daddaatǝr kǝ Alekzanda ard Rufus, saas ma gǝdzǝr kǝssa, ar faraa baɗ ndzǝɗ kǝ kǝssa tlaɓa hǝrta Yesu.
Ar langda kǝ Yesu da vakavakiin kwa ɗahav dǝ Golgata, (dǝgiti tuuk vakai nǝ iina “Vakka kuwa ghǝra”).
Vǝlarar vaakwahiin nǝ iitǝr kǝ yuwa innabi laɓalaɓan dǝ mur
, luwa kǝ hǝɓgaana.
Ar hǝrtǝtta. Ar tagwna dlaɓ kǝ sǝɗavahaan ma taatakaatǝra, kaa tsa tsats kǝ iitǝr tǝghǝr kiyava vaza dǝgiti aa tlǝkǝna aanji waratǝra.
Hǝrtarǝt ma sarta vaslambaɗa dlakadura.
Ar vinda tǝ tlaɓa hǝrtǝg kǝ ǝlbǝgi ghwudararva nǝ iitǝr taakiya, “TLƏKƏSSA YAHUDAHA.”
Ar hǝrtǝt kǝ gǝlah buwa ǝmtaɗ dǝ iina, pal tǝ dǝvaa kaffaana, pal dlaɓ tǝ dǝvaa ghyaɓɓaana. [
Kwan iin nǝ righǝgga tlayangǝr kwa tagaa taakiya, “Kǝdlavǝna ma lii haipaha.”
Uudahi ghudadagal ar tagar ǝlbǝga nenega, ar gajaga ghǝr ar taakiya, “Caa! Kǝghi agha dlagǝnadlag kǝ vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla, dlaɓa agha da gwiya ndǝrant bamma hǝng hǝkǝrɗa,
katǝg ci kǝ ghǝragha, agha sii bi dlaɓ tǝ tlaɓa hǝrtǝg biya!”
Bandkwah dlaɓ nǝ maalah ma zhiilakǝsauufah ard lii tsaga adzahadzaha Musa, kaa nenegaan kǝ iitǝr ma taatakaatǝr ar taakiya, “Katǝghankatǝg kǝ kyalǝma, pilgharvaapilǝg kata ghǝraana!

Aa sasii ci ndan Kǝristi tlǝkǝssa Israˈilǝn ndakwan tǝ tlaɓa hǝrtǝgǝna, kiyava nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝskǝmnd kǝm fǝdghǝrǝta!” Baz gǝlahǝn hǝrtavǝt ǝmtaɗ dǝ iinǝn ndakwani kaa taa ǝlbǝgahi ghwaɗghwaɗ kǝ iitǝr tǝ iina.
Əmtsǝga Yesu
Bad vacci tǝghǝra, kaa hǝɗgarduhǝɗǝg nǝ gurtl kǝ lard baɗǝma, tangw damma hǝkǝrɗa hwassa.
Tǝhalakwaha, sarta hǝkǝrɗa hwaasa, kaa dzagantdzǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ kuungy bad halavuwa ndzǝɗaan, amaa, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” Iin taakiya, “Daadamazhigǝl Daadamazhigǝla, agha fiikwada daɓawi?”
Cinngara ba nǝ lii ghaciga vaakwahiin kwaha, aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Wai nǝ iin ɗaa tlaiyang Iliya.”
Kaa ǝmdǝrǝg kǝ pallǝraatǝra, rǝmda kǝ abarabar dǝ yuwa inabi kwarekreka tǝ zadda, vǝlar kǝ Yesu kiyava hǝɓɓǝga, aiyama, “Vazyamvazǝg ndana! Mbatak da sagau nǝ tlayang Iliya da sii dǝ vakaiya.”
Kaa dzǝgantdzǝg Yesu kǝ kungy bad halavuuwa ndzǝɗaana, tǝhalakwaha, kaa ɗiya shifǝgga halavuuwana, ǝmtsana.
Kaa tǝhgǝmtǝhǝg kǝ ɓǝlyaɓǝlya Vǝgya Daadamaazhigǝl hutsǝg buwa ciigǝt ma ghǝraan tangw damma suhwaana.
Nǝgha ban nǝ tlaujin ndza ghaciga tǝvuukwa Yesu kǝ ɗuuli ǝmtsa nǝ iina, aiyama, “Ba pakat uudanǝn Zǝra Daadamazhigǝla!”
Kyalma ǝnghwasaha, ghaccara ba ndzaɗɗa ar vazǝggaana. Ma iitǝra mǝng Maryam Magadala, ard Maryam babba Yakub kudǝrkudǝra ard Isuvuwa, ard Salomi.
Gatarars ciigǝt sagat ma Galili nǝ ǝnghwasahaan ar ba mǝlgarumǝlga. Dlaɓa baɗyak nǝ kyalǝma ǝnghwasah kwa darǝt ǝmtaɗ dǝ iin ma Wurshalim ndakwi ndzar ba vaakwaha.
Hǝɗa Yesu
Ɗǝm ba faciya hwaasa, kaa ɓadlav kǝ uudaha, aɗaba dlakaduraan Faciya Ngiiga.

Kaa sagal kǝ uuda nǝ iin ma Arimatiya ɗaagaan Isuvuwa. Pall ma gyiɗya lii maalmala nǝ iina, dlaɓa fǝvaarafǝga, kwa pakka saaya tlǝkkǝssǝra Daadamazhigǝla. Shughanashug kǝ gyi da vak Bilatus, da ghala ma vǝlvar nǝ tlǝwa vǝgha Yesu.
Cinngha ba nǝ Bilatus taakiya ǝmtsaǝmtsǝg nǝ Yesu, vǝlgharvǝlǝg kǝ dǝga ajappǝra. Ɗahant kǝ iin kǝ maala tlaujiin ndavaru taakiya bak jiirjiira ha ǝmtsaǝmtsǝg nǝ Yesu.
Cinngha ba nǝ iin vak maala tlaujin taakiya band kwaha, kaa vǝlar kǝ iin kǝ Isuvu kǝ tlǝwa vǝgha Yesu.

Kaa sǝgwdaasǝgw nǝ Isuvu kǝ kǝlpakana, sǝddi kǝ iin kǝ tlǝwa Yesu tǝ tlaɓa hǝrtǝgga, faɗant ma kǝlpakana, fǝdǝm kǝ iin ma gǝtl kwa kwaɗava ma kura. Tǝhala kwaha, hutambardi kǝ akura hǝɗardu kǝ iin kǝ ghaiyan dǝ vakaiya.
Nǝghǝranǝghǝg nǝ Maryamu Magadala ard Maryamu babba Isuvu kǝ vakavaki fava dǝ tlǝwa vǝgha Yesu.

footnotes.text: Mur laɓalaɓan dǝ yuwa inabi, vǝlvar kǝ daddakwa hǝrtǝvǝt dǝ hǝrtǝg kiyava kǝhyǝgarna dlaɗa.
Kyalǝma vindǝgahi ndza wura, ar maay dǝ kwanǝn kǝ aay biya.
